acceptance.reason: The actual well has opposite source/return potentials across the soma. A one-compartment surface mean can cancel spatial polarization; test axial spherical bands before certifying the coupled model. This adds axial resolution, not circumferential nonlinear patches.
acceptance.selection: Keep every amplitude and intervention. A supported soma resolution requires two consecutive declared refinement comparisons to meet all applicable limits, without changing the density/geometry hypothesis or tolerances. Nonrecruitment is a valid biological outcome; a numerical comparison cannot omit its differing recruitment result.
acceptance.fieldPolicy: Identical external soma/neurite exclusion geometry and field solve for every soma subdivision; only surface-band averages and electrical axial segmentation change. The final report must identify frozen field/production sources; prototype results are exploratory.
acceptance.failurePolicy: Preserve every failed soma comparison and any numerical-source failure. Do not certify the one-compartment approximation solely because its independent native solver agrees.

cell.topology: own peripheral and central projections; fixed assumed geometry

channel.contactMeaning: Proposed finite rectangular inner-sidewall patches; actual contact topology and area are returned by the field mesh.

fieldDiagnostics.discretization: conforming P1 tetrahedral FEM with explicit removed insulating volumes
fieldDiagnostics.sourceModel: finite surface current density on explicit inner-wall patches
fieldDiagnostics.wallBoundary: natural zero normal flux; no conductive wall tetrahedra retained
fieldDiagnostics.apertureModel: explicit annular conducting bore and access volume
fieldDiagnostics.outerBoundary: zero Dirichlet on outer cylindrical polygon and both ends
fieldDiagnostics.cellRepresentation: Explicit soma/stem/near-well neurite exclusion; distal cables embedded in effective endoneurial tensor

apertures.meaning: Resolved bore voltage drop divided by discrete aperture current; source/access impedance is separate. Null resistance means current too small for a stable ratio.
